# Aetheria — Interactive 3D Developer Portfolio (Dmytro Hnylytskyi)

> Aetheria is the bilingual (English / Ukrainian) portfolio and resume of Dmytro Hnylytskyi, a Full-Stack & Creative 3D Developer based in Kyiv, Ukraine. One URL hosts two complete experiences: a structured classic resume and an explorable 3D WebGL outpost with real physics, six crew NPCs, a crew dossier and a tactical map.

- Canonical: https://hnylytskyi.dev
- Full machine-readable passport (everything a visitor can see and do): https://hnylytskyi.dev/llms-full.txt
- Last verified: 2026-10-22
- Languages: English (default) and Ukrainian (`?lang=uk`)
- Default view: classic resume (`?mode=classic`); the 3D world is at `?mode=3d`
- License: PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 for original code/design; KayKit Space Base Bits and Character Animations are CC0 1.0

## Two modes on one route

- [Classic resume](https://hnylytskyi.dev/?mode=classic): a server-rendered, crawlable, 8-section CV landing page. This is the text surface for crawlers and the fallback for any device.
- [3D outpost](https://hnylytskyi.dev/?mode=3d): a lazy-loaded WebGL experience. Third-person character, Rapier physics, 1,059 authored objects, six interactive crew members, dialogue, dossier, tactical map and a continuous day/night cycle.
- [Ukrainian version](https://hnylytskyi.dev/?lang=uk): full translation of both modes; the URL parameter wins over the stored preference.

## What a visitor can do

### Classic resume

- Read the hero summary, selected work, about, education, skills, verified certifications and contacts.
- Filter the four projects by clicking any technology tag (skills section or project card); the toolbar shows `N / 4`.
- Open a project details modal with preview, description, features, stack, Live Demo and GitHub links.
- Switch dark/light by scrubbing the day/night slider in the header (or the fallback theme button on small screens).
- Toggle ambient audio (muted by default).
- Switch EN / UA without reloading.
- Open the 3D world via the `3D` button, the “Launch 3D Experience” banner, the orbital artifact or the footer.
- Print or save the CV as PDF via the “Download PDF” button (it opens the browser print dialog with a dedicated print document).
- Copy the email address; open email, Telegram or GitHub.
- Use the skip link, keyboard focus, and back-to-top control.

### 3D outpost

- Watch or skip the first-visit cinematic intro; replay it later from the Controls guide.
- Walk (WASD / arrows), sprint (Shift), jump (Space), orbit the camera (click to lock the pointer, then move the mouse; right-side drag on touch), zoom (wheel / pinch).
- Talk to six crew members with `[E]` when the interaction pill appears within ~2.5 m.
- Open the crew dossier materials: bio, skills, contacts, Forma-3D, TerraScope, Lumina.
- Track progress in the `Crew N/6` chip and the `Materials N/6` counter; state survives reloads in `localStorage`.
- Open the tactical map with `M` or the radar button; click any pin or row to jump straight to that dossier/project.
- Scrub time of day from midnight to noon to midnight; the DOM theme follows the cycle.
- Switch back to the classic resume at any time without a page reload; language, theme and dossier persist.

## Visual identity

- Classic: editorial monochrome (black/white), Space Grotesk headlines, glass panels, thin borders, large radii, numbered sections 01–08, warm accent driven by the time-of-day engine, a WebGL gravitational-singularity background and a kinetic orbital artifact in the hero.
- 3D: stylized low-poly sci-fi outpost from KayKit Space Base, a multi-tier platform over a baked Earth-like planet, a shattered moon, broken orbital arcs and a gravitational singularity. Each sector has its own accent colour (gold, violet, emerald, sapphire, rose coral, cyan).
- The 3D view is a WebGL canvas with DOM HUD layers. Text crawlers cannot see it; the classic resume is the crawlable surface.

## For AI evaluators

- Read this file for orientation and `llms-full.txt` for the complete inventory.
- For visual evaluation, open the site in a browser at desktop and mobile sizes and capture rendered frames. The full passport contains a deterministic protocol using `?debug` (teleport to crew, fixed camera, time of day, renderer stats).
- Do not judge 3D visuals from this text alone; the scene is procedural and quality-tier dependent.
- Audio is muted by default and never autoplays.

## Source of truth

- `src/data/resumeData.ts` — profile, projects, education, certifications, skills, UI copy
- `src/data/npcDialogues.ts` — six crew scripts and actions
- `src/data/zones.ts` — sector names, colours, coordinates, visit order
- `src/data/tacticalLandmarks.ts` — tactical map pins
- `src/data/islandScene.json` — 1,059 placed objects, spawn point, yaw
- `src/components/ui/ControlsGuideDropdown.tsx` — keyboard and touch controls
- `src/components/3d/CharacterController.tsx` — movement, camera, intro
- `src/store/debugState.ts` — quality tiers and QA bridge

## Notes and caveats

- The 3D canvas is not accessible to screen readers; the classic resume is the accessible text equivalent.
- “Download PDF” opens the browser print dialog; the visitor chooses “Save as PDF”.
- “60 FPS” is a performance target, not a guarantee on every device.
- `llms-full.txt` lists two small copy inconsistencies visible in the 3D dialogue (the profile data is authoritative).
- This site has no accounts, no backend API, no analytics and no cookies; preferences live in `localStorage`.
